content: MCP Python SDK v2.0.0 (mcp package on PyPI). MCPServer from mcp.server.mcpserver is the high-level API. Decorator pattern: @mcp.tool() registers a function as a tool; type hints become the JSON Schema. mcp.run(transport='stdio') is a synchronous entry point. The low-level Server class is in mcp.server.lowlevel. stdio_server() context manager in mcp.server.stdio provides read/write streams for the low-level Server. Client(mcp) from mcp client accepts server object directly for in-process testing. asyncio-based throughout. Requires Python >=3.10.
